sloka: हर्यश्वस्य मरुः पुत्रो मरोः पुत्रः प्रतीन्धकः ।प्रतीन्धकस्य धर्मात्मा राजा कीर्तिरथः सुतः ॥१-७१-९॥
transliteration: haryaśvasya maruḥ putro maroḥ putraḥ pratīndhakaḥ ।pratīndhakasya dharmātmā rājā kīrtirathaḥ sutaḥ ॥1-71-9॥

translations.english: Haryasva's son was Maru, father of Pratindhaka. Pratindhaka's son was the righteous king Kirtiratha.
